column5: The collector calls runAnalyzer without options, leaving execFileSync's default output buffer limit for the full git map.
The full map uses execFileSync's default buffer limit, and opts.top truncates hotspots only after the output is parsed.
adjustForAi is documented and accepted but never read, so the bus factor always uses unadjusted human commit counts.
The bus factor calculation never checks adjustForAi, producing the same result for true and false.
